text:
nina-partners: FYI GreenRack (hardware partner) just reported a marketplace provisioning mismatch where dedicated instances are assigned the wrong SKU; customers see 'instance-type-undefined'. They asked for a clear SEV path — do we have a partner-level escalation template?

raj-eng: Not a great time. Can you paste the failing API payload?

nina-partners: Sample: `{"listing_id":"gr-778","region":"us-west-2","sku":null}` Lots of null skus.

tori-sre: I'm taking lead. Suggest we follow 'partner-shared-channel' flow: create #partners-greenrack-sev, open a war room, and assign roles. Also, for hardware partners we should add a 'hardware on-call' contact in the matrix.

partner-bot: Shared channel created: #partners-greenrack-sev. War room: https://redwood.warrooms/1779009001

olivia-support: Opening ticket with GreenRack now. Can someone confirm which customers are affected? Ben - any sales readouts?

ben-sales: Two enterprise customers in us-west-2. One in evaluation. I'll DM the account reps and join the war room. Need to coordinate a joint status note.

raj-eng: Quick triage steps: check mapping table `sku_mapping_v2` and the staging webhook consumer. Command: `psql -c "select listing_id, sku from sku_mapping_v2 where listing_id='gr-778'"`

olivia-support: Confirmed impacted customers list: cust-az, cust-bc, cust-eval. Draft status to customers: "We're investigating an issue causing marketplace listings to provision with missing SKU values. We've opened a joint war room with our partner and will update in 20 minutes."

nina-partners: Partner escalation contacts (GreenRack): hw-oncall@greenrack.com, se-ops@greenrack.com, matt.p@greenrack.com (principal PM). We should also ensure there is a hardware runbook reference for firmware/sku sync steps.

tori-sre: Proposed escalation matrix for hardware partners to add to partners runbook:
- T0: Shared channel + war room. Roles: Incident lead (Redwood SRE), Partner liaison (Partner PM), Eng triage (Redwood Eng), Support lead (Redwood Support).
- T+10m: Confirm impact, request partner logs and firmware sync status.
- T+20m: If unresolved, page hardware on-call AND the partner exec.
- T+45m: Open customer bridge and prepare rollback/mitigation (reassign SKU default or pause provisioning).

raj-eng: I'll open a hotfix to set a default SKU if mapping is null, behind a feature flag. PR coming.

partner-bot: Pager: pages sent to @tori-sre and @raj-eng

ben-sales: Request to add a 'customer comms' owner in the matrix and a template that mentions expected ETA, mitigation steps, and a contact for escalation.

nina-partners: Agreed. After this resolves let's schedule a 30-minute sync with GreenRack's PM to formalize the on-call contacts and update the runbook with a hardware-specific escalation flow.

olivia-support: Will capture a postmortem and append the partner-notes section. Will tag partners-runbook PR with the incident ref.

nina-partners: Thanks everyone. Please keep updates in #partners-greenrack-sev — closing the thread here once the partner confirms the SKU sync completed.
